<thought>Based on the mass spectrum (M⁺· at m/z 194.086, matching C₁₂H₁₅Cl) and the ¹H NMR (10 H aliphatic CH₂ at 1.35 ppm, 1 H benzylic CH at 2.63 ppm, and a para‑disubstituted aromatic pattern of 4 H at ~7.3 ppm), the structure is a para‑chlorophenyl attached to a cyclohexyl group. The validated SMILES for this molecule is Clc1ccc(cc1)C2CCCCC2.</thought>
<final_answer>Clc1ccc(cc1)C2CCCCC2</final_answer>
